rows.html:
Discussion on the future of P2P invoicing process with AI solutions as a support:
Vendor Query Management
Duplicate Invoice Trace
Vendor Reconciliation
Exception handling
Common Collector Mailbox
How many platforms we need to have in the interim solution before UNIFY coming. Eventually, what will be the target model after UNIFY, Titan
Decommissioning risk and technical debt created by the interim solution

Identified interim solution needs:
Interim solutions:
3 AI agents to process invoice exception handling for APS OCR failures for legacy FERPs.
Agent 1 is already in production.
Agents 2 and 3 integration with legacy FERP design and cost estimate is ongoing.
Exception to implement solution in FERP to be validated by Design Authority.
Recommend: on hold and budget to be validated -> Action on Digital Finance.
Request of a duplicate payment solution for UNIFY before Xelix or Oversight go-live in July 2027. Galvanize usage in UNIFY is under investigation as it would require connecting UNIFY to a non best-of-breed solution. Topic to be brought to Enterprise Architecture.
NOT interim solutions:
Xelix/Oversight for VQM, duplicate payment optimization, vendor statement reconciliation.
Common Collector Mailbox is currently deprioritized for 2026.
Principle is to use the same technology everywhere. Investigation on standards for KunPeng not yet conducted.
China operates its own applications for invoice management which properly support local regulatory requirements. The only open point to clarify is the strategy for Taiwan and Hong Kong.
